method: Stream every canonical CGB3 game from DatasetReader, replay up to the published CPI depth with Shakmaty, and independently aggregate first-visit position/next-move WDL counts for fixed opening positions. Compare the move-keyed aggregates against direct CPI v2 lookups. The scan validates every replayed move and excludes unknown-result games from WDL counts.
limitations: The oracle starts from canonical CGB3 records, not the original source PGN, so it does not independently verify source-to-canonical mapping or upstream metadata preservation.
It shares the repository's compute_position_key function with CPI extraction; move replay and aggregation are independent, but the position-key encoding itself is not independently reimplemented.
Only the listed positions are independently aggregated; this is not a complete re-indexing of every position.
